Case note: CC/2368/2025
Client: Madhuri More (textile trader, Thane)
Opposing party: Gaurav Mehra
Court: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Thane
Filed on: 5 September 2025
Claim amount: ₹13,40,000
Issue: cheque bounce. The cheque was returned unpaid for insufficient funds.
Advice given: Send a statutory demand notice to the drawer and file the complaint if the drawer does not pay.
Outcome: The drawer paid the full cheque amount after the first hearing.
Recommended next step: Withdraw the complaint once the payment clears.
